environment: Node 22.14 and PostgreSQL 17.11 using private local fixtures
observations: A real checkpoint row lock timed out before the contender acquired a claim. The HTTPS refusal left the contender usable.

While an unrelated reservation was held, the application rolled back a fresh request and safely deferred receipt reconciliation. The worker deferred both reconciliation and a capacity reservation, released the reconciliation lease and made no provider call.

When the first reservation cleared, the same worker completed the pending job with one simulated provider call. An acknowledged receipt briefly deferred during a separate pending reservation and then returned its original completion.
The same application writer retried its original operation key and accepted the fresh request after the reservation cleared.
Pre-aborted calls did not poison the writer. Existing mutation-response loss, crash, expired reservation and fenced recovery regressions remained green.
scope: The provider was simulated. The source transaction, observer, app and worker journal clients, HTTPS authority process, leases, reservations and independent checkpoint database were real local implementations.
The optional billing PostgreSQL unit skip is exercised in the wire suite.
Hosted provider verification, alert delivery, capacity succession and release activation remain separate.
